purpose: MFRM module validation protocol. Committed before any cross-package comparison (only a TAM tooling run and the Python logLik mapping identity on the balanced fixture preceded it).
model: rating-scale MFRM: log P(k)/P(k-1) = theta - delta_item - lambda_rater [- gamma_task] - tau_k; theta ~ N(mu, sigma^2)

engine.identification: item, each facet and step parameters sum to zero; mu and sigma^2 estimated
engine.convergence_gate: iterations < maxiter, else every output is withheld

references.identity_python: independent Python likelihood/probability code using TAM's reported parameters, mean, variance and nodes
references.mfrmr: mfrmr 0.2.4 fit_mfrm(model = 'RSM', method = 'MML', quad_points = 61): same objective (MML, normal latent), different quadrature (Gauss–Hermite) and optimizer
references.rasch: rasch 1.12.1 rasch_mfrm: pairwise conditional ML (different objective) — recovery of known truth only, never equality with MML
references.facets_software: not used: no legally available FACETS output; no FACETS-equivalence is claimed

tolerances.identity_wle: <= 1e-4 for WLE and SE (independent Newton solution of Warm's equation)
tolerances.mfrmr_facets_thresholds: <= 5e-3 logits after both are centred to sum zero (quadrature rule and optimizer differ)
tolerances.recovery: TAM and rasch facet/threshold estimates within max(3 SE, 0.15) of the generating value (balanced, unbalanced, four-facet)
tolerances.fit_separation: Python formulas recomputed independently; compared with mfrmr only if its documented definition is identical, else not certified
tolerances.interaction: LR = deviance(main) - deviance(item:rater); df = npars difference; requires both fits converged

status_rules.CERTIFIED: fixture-scope only: identity checks pass and mfrmr agreement within tolerance on balanced AND unbalanced fixtures
status_rules.PARTIAL: identity/formula evidence or a single fixture only, or a definition that differs from FACETS; shown with an explicit label
status_rules.NOT CERTIFIED: no valid evidence: output withheld with a Turkish explanation

fail_closed: missing person/item/rater/score columns or empty IDs
privacy: person identifiers are not exported unless the user opts in
compute_budget: deterministic fixtures only; no Monte Carlo; each fit < 60 s
